variants.label: Guided fishing trip on Lake Michigan targeting salmon and other fish

blurb: FishBilly Charters offers guided fishing trips targeting salmon and other fish on Lake Michigan. They tailor trips to guests' interests and pursue the best bite throughout the year. Fish cleaning services are available at Carlson's Fishery or on trips out of Port of Frankfort.
extraNote: $5 per fish cleaning at Carlson’s Fishery in Leland during business hours · FishBilly Charters can clean your catch for tips when Carlson’s is closed · Fish cleaning not available on all trips; only when fishing out of Port of Frankfort
